name: @projexlight/sdk-notification
summary: Multichannel notification fan-out for ProjexCloud: SMS + email + push + voice + in-app, driven by named templates with localization + brand kits. Quiet-hours engine respects per-recipient + per-tenant DND windows; channel fallback (SMS fails → email) is configured per template. Source-of-truth for any outbound customer + tech + operator message.

endpoints.description: Send a notification (template-driven or raw). Returns message_id + per-channel status.
Create or update a notification template (multi-channel, multi-locale).
Set per-recipient or per-tenant quiet-hours windows. Repeat-sends inside a window are deferred or routed to a fallback channel.

events.name: notification.message.sent.v1
events.description: Notification accepted by the carrier/provider; per-channel transit.

events.name: notification.message.failed.v1
events.description: All channel attempts failed; carries error class + which fallback (if any) was used.

events.name: notification.template.published.v1
events.description: New template version published; carries the diff vs. prior version.

models.description: Per-template definition: name, version, channels, localized bodies, fallback chain.
Per-send row: template_ref or raw body, recipient, channel, status, delivery_at.

hooks.name: sendNotification
hooks.description: Service entry — accepts template + recipient, returns message_id + channel statuses.

hooks.name: publishTemplate
hooks.description: Publish a new template version; idempotent on (name, version).

hooks.name: setQuietHours
hooks.description: Set per-recipient or per-tenant quiet-hours window.

hooks.name: startProviderWebhook
hooks.description: Stand up the webhook receiver for carrier callbacks (delivery, opens, replies).

scenarios.title: Tech route materialized → customer 'tech on the way' SMS
scenarios.when_to_use: Reactive on dispatch.route.materialized.v1 — pull the next stop's customer + send a templated SMS with the ETA window.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Returns message_id + per-channel status. Customer gets the SMS within ~10 sec. Emits .sent.v1 immediately; .delivered.v1 once Twilio confirms.

scenarios.title: Marketing nudge respects per-customer quiet hours
scenarios.when_to_use: Outbound marketing/billing reminder; sender doesn't track timezones — the engine respects the customer's quiet-hours window + defers to the next-allowed slot.
scenarios.expected_outcome: If now is inside the recipient's quiet-hours window, the message is queued for the next allowed slot (e.g. 09:00 in their tz). Emits .sent.v1 at actual send time.

scenarios.title: SMS fails → automatic email fallback
scenarios.when_to_use: Carrier returns 'invalid number'; template specifies fallback chain SMS → email. Engine retries on the next channel without operator intervention.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Email goes out; emits .sent.v1 on the email + .failed.v1 on the SMS leg. Customer reachable + message delivered without escalation.

scenarios.title: Storm declared → oncall paged via voice + Slack
scenarios.when_to_use: Reactive on storm.event.declared.v1 — high-priority operator page; the template is 'oncall-storm-page' which routes through voice + Slack simultaneously (no fallback, both required).
scenarios.expected_outcome: PagerDuty + Slack channel both fire within ~5 sec. ignore_quiet_hours flag honored because operator pages are P1. Emits .sent.v1 per channel + .delivered.v1 when ack'd.

scenarios.title: Publish v1.1 of the ETA template with a richer route preview
scenarios.when_to_use: Template change with backward-compat — old in-flight messages keep referencing v1.0.0 while new sends pick up v1.1.0.
scenarios.expected_outcome: v1.1.0 active for new sends. Emits .template.published.v1 with diff. v1.0.0 retained for replay + audit.

compliance_posture.notes: TCPA + CAN-SPAM require recorded consent per recipient + per channel + an opt-out path; sdk-consent + sdk-notification join via recipient.persona_id. Quiet-hours engine respects do-not-disturb windows. Provider webhooks update delivered/failed status, persisted for the per-message audit trail.
